A.label: objects-hands-chart (no text)
A.why: baseline: the kind of plate the catalogue is full of — motion + mood, zero glyphs
A.prompt: Vertical 9:16. A hand slides a stack of banknotes across a black glass table under a single red neon strip. Behind it, an out-of-focus candlestick chart glows red on a monitor. Slow dolly-in, shallow depth of field, cinematic. Pure black background, red neon rim light, no on-screen text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.

B.label: phone screen, English UI text
B.why: the claim 'RETURN 35%/MONTH' needs legible English on a phone
B.prompt: Vertical 9:16. Close-up of a hand holding a smartphone in a dark room lit by red neon. The phone screen shows a trading app with the large English text 'RETURN 35% / MONTH' and a green 'DEPOSIT' button below it. Slow push-in on the screen, text stays sharp and readable. Black background, red rim light, cinematic.

C.label: court document, English
C.why: legal-notice beat — does a printed page hold letterforms
C.prompt: Vertical 9:16. Overhead shot of an official English-language court summons on a dark desk, header reading 'NOTICE OF SEIZURE', a rubber stamp and a pen beside it. A hand enters frame and slides the paper forward. Hard red neon from the side, deep shadows, cinematic, text sharp and legible.

D.label: bank transfer screen, English
D.prompt: Vertical 9:16. Close-up of a laptop screen in a dark room showing an English bank transfer confirmation: 'TRANSFER FAILED' in red, an account number partly blurred, and a 'RETRY' button. Camera drifts slowly right. Red neon glow on black, cinematic, on-screen text sharp and readable.
